title: Drop the QUEST_SOURCE_REF source-build fallback now that quest 0.14.1 is on npm (floor: ci.yml, release.yml)
description: ci.yml:156 and release.yml:80 pin QUEST_SOURCE_REF (053d8595, DEC-55) so setup-quest builds quest from source while the paired quest version was not yet on npm. Both comments say so ("quest 0.14.1 is not on npm yet, so the source path is what runs until it is published"). quest 0.14.1 and lore 0.14.1 are both published (lore dist-tags.latest 0.14.1, GitHub Release v0.14.1 2026-10-20T13:41:05Z), so the premise is gone, the comments are now false, and every CI job (three in ci.yml, one in release.yml) still builds quest from a pinned commit instead of installing the published binary the user gets. The pin also must be hand-moved on every pair bump, and test/release-workflow.test.ts and test/ci-workflow.test.ts pin its presence and agreement across the two files. FLOOR WORK: touches release.yml, so a reviewer pass is required before it lands, per the repo delegation rule. Not started; waits for the leader plan. Open design point to settle before building: whether setup-quest keeps its source-ref input as an opt-in escape hatch for a future interim crossing (recommended: keep the input, drop the pin) or loses it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml and release.yml no longer define QUEST_SOURCE_REF, and no setup-quest step passes a source-ref taken from it; the stale comments about quest not being on npm are removed or corrected
setup-quest resolves quest from npm at the version CLAUDE.md declares, in every job that used the pin, and still asserts the installed quest reports that version

test/ci-workflow.test.ts and test/release-workflow.test.ts are updated so no test requires the pin, and a mutation that reintroduces a stale or mismatched pin, or removes the version assertion, turns a test red
a CI run on the PR head is green for every required context on dev (read live from the ruleset), with a run on a Windows leg proving the npm install path works there
a reviewer pass on the change is recorded on this task before it lands
